proposals.before: He was soon made grand general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Jing Province.
proposals.after: He was soon made grand general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Jingzhou (涇州).
proposals.reason: Chinese has 涇州刺史 (Jingzhou 涇州), not 荊州; idiomatic English collapses this into ambiguous “Jing Province.”

proposals.before: There was also a guest dining with Pi on melon; (Ke xiao gua) emended: the guest pared the melon, cutting the flesh rather thick; Pi inwardly disliked it.
proposals.after: There was also a guest dining with Pi on melon; the guest pared the melon, cutting the flesh rather thick; Pi inwardly disliked it.
proposals.reason: Literal English contains a corrupted editorial insertion “(Ke xiao gua) emended:” absent from the Chinese.

decisions.after: He was soon made grand general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Jingzhou (Jing Prefecture).
decisions.reason: s0026 has 涇州刺史, the northern Jingzhou (Jing Prefecture), not 荊州. The revised replacement removes untranslated Chinese from the English field while preserving the needed distinction.
s0061 Chinese is only 又有客與羆食瓜，客削瓜侵膚稍厚，羆意嫌之; the parenthetical “(Ke xiao gua) emended:” is an editorial artifact absent from the source, and removing it leaves an accurate literal rendering.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 又有客與羆食瓜，客削瓜侵膚稍厚，羆意嫌之
